newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan deports Philippine murder suspect.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan deports Philippine murder suspect.

text.p: Taiwan on Thursday deported a Filipino murder suspect who sneaked into the island from the Philippines in 1996 using a false passport, investigators said.

"We handed to the Philippines police the suspect, Lorenzo Damogo, who was wanted by his country on charges of a double murder in 1994," a spokesman for Taiwan's Investigation Bureau said by telephone.

He said Damogo entered Taiwan on August 9, 1996 using the passport of Paolo Dongloy, and began working illegally in the southern city of Nantou. Philippine police in April requested help from Taiwan to arrest Damogo.
Taiwan investigators tracked down Damogo on Thursday and took him to the Taipei international airport, where he was detained by two police officers from the Philippines.

Taiwan and the Philippines do not have official relations or a formal extradition agreement, but both countries have a general agreement to assist each other in arresting fugitives, the bureau spokesman said.
